content: Many sentences contain spans tagged by the LSTM-CRF-Pattern model, but missed by all crowd workers, resulting in a maximally difficult score (1). Inspection of such sentences revealed that some are truly difficult examples, but others are tagging model errors. In either case, such sentences have confused workers and/or the model, and so we retain them all as `difficult' sentences.
